subject: MUSIQ kickoff — IQA scoring API + quality leaderboard
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kicking off the MUSIQ productization. We're starting from a strong place: the open-source release ships inference code and checkpoints trained on four datasets (ava_ckpt, koniq_ckpt, paq2piq_ckpt, spaq_ckpt), with the default model taking 3-scale input — native resolution plus 224 and 384. No training needed for v1; this is a packaging and serving play.

Two deliverables this quarter:
1. An internal image-quality scoring API on Shipyard, MUSIQ under the hood, for the vision portfolio's data-filtering pipelines.
2. A benchmark leaderboard service so quality models get tracked over time instead of living in one-off spreadsheets.

Milestones: serving prototype by 05-15, leaderboard MVP by mid-June, Launch Review Board readout before 07-13. Resourcing proposal from you next, please — especially who builds the leaderboard.

Lucia
